boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, visually documentable stops on Main Street, Route 108, and adjoining downtown corridors near Slippery Rock University.

cards.title: Roxy Park’s flower-lined link
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk through the flower-filled walkway connecting South Main Street and the Entrance parking lot; use it as a short downtown-to-parking cut-through.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped pedestrian connection just off South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Development describes Roxy Park as a flower-filled walkway linking South Main Street to the Entrance parking lot.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor walkway; follow posted conditions and event closures.

cards.title: Gateway Park’s double waterfall
cards.subtitle: New Castle Street (Route 108) corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the natural-rock double waterfall beside Route 108, then continue toward the South Main Street downtown blocks on foot.
cards.short_summary: A named gateway feature with a double waterfall.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Development states that Gateway Park, bordering a renovated parking lot along Route 108, includes a double waterfall feature.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor feature beside Route 108; use marked pedestrian routes.

cards.title: The downtown gazebo gathering point
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the gazebo as a visual meeting point while exploring the rebuilt South Main Street blocks and nearby public streetscape features.
cards.short_summary: A downtown gazebo created as part of the revitalization project.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Development says the Main Street project constructed a gazebo for community gathering.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-space feature; check event setup before entering the area.

cards.title: The Main Street welcome mural
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Look for the mural near North Country Brewing and photograph the public artwork from the sidewalk without blocking business entrances.
cards.short_summary: A locally designed mural that welcomes people to town.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Development says the Main Street mural was designed and created by local artist Sean Swihart and welcomes visitors to Slippery Rock.
cards.access_notes: View from public sidewalks and respect adjacent business access.

cards.title: A community-library stop
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit the library at 465 N. Main St. for its public services, activities, and technology; confirm the day’s hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: The town’s community library on North Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slippery Rock Community Library lists its address as 465 N. Main St. and publishes public library hours.
cards.access_notes: Hours listed by the library vary by day; check its current contact page before visiting.

cards.title: Community Park’s pavilion area
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter from the 320 N. Main St. park address and orient yourself using the upper Rotary and lower Veteran’s Pavilion references.
cards.short_summary: A named community park with separately identified pavilion areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Area Parks & Recreation lists its park address at 320 N. Main St. and identifies Rotary and Veteran’s pavilions there.
cards.source_title: Pavilion Rentals | Slippery Rock Area Parks & Recreation
cards.access_notes: Park amenities may be reserved; observe posted rules and avoid reserved pavilion areas.

cards.title: Rotary Pavilion by the flag site
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Find the Rotary Pavilion at the park’s upper entrance near the flag site, and check whether the pavilion is reserved before using it.
cards.short_summary: The park’s upper pavilion, near the flag site.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Area Parks & Recreation identifies the Rotary Pavilion at the upper park entrance by the flag site.
cards.source_title: Pavilion Rentals | Slippery Rock Area Parks & Recreation
cards.access_notes: The pavilion is rentable; do not use it when reserved.

cards.title: Veteran’s Pavilion at the lower entrance
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the park’s lower entrance by the office to locate the Veteran’s Pavilion; leave the space clear when a scheduled rental is underway.
cards.short_summary: The park’s lower pavilion near the office entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Slippery Rock Area Parks & Recreation places the Veteran’s Pavilion at the park’s lower entrance by the office.
cards.source_title: Pavilion Rentals | Slippery Rock Area Parks & Recreation
cards.access_notes: The pavilion is rentable; do not use it when reserved.

cards.title: Made-to-order Thai food
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 126 S. Main St. for made-to-order Thai dishes; review the restaurant’s current menu and opening days before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A Thai restaurant with an official South Main Street location.
cards.evidence_claim: Elephant #8 Thai Taste lists its Slippery Rock location at 126 S Main St. and says dishes are made to order from scratch.
cards.access_notes: The business lists Monday as closed and Tuesday–Sunday service; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Coffee and donuts on South Main
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the official location at 304 S. Main St. as a straightforward coffee-and-donut stop while moving through the South Main corridor.
cards.short_summary: A chain coffee and donut stop at 304 South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin’s official location page lists its Slippery Rock store at 304 S Main St.
cards.source_title: Dunkin’ at 304 S Main St, Slippery Rock
cards.access_notes: Confirm current store hours and available menu items on the official location page.
